programs.title: Antiques Downunder
programs.desc: The Antiques DownUnder team heads to the Hellenic Museum in Melbourne; Musician Jed Hudson's impressive guitar collection hits all the right notes; Gregory comes across a ring made from the original gold nugget.

programs.title: Not Now, Comrade
programs.desc: The story of a famous Russian male ballet-dancer who defects to Britain, where chaos befalls to those who try to help him. (Lewis Fiander, Richard Marner, Michael Sharvell-Martin).

programs.title: Antiques Roadshow
programs.desc: Fiona Bruce and the team pay a return visit to Kirby Hall in Northamptonshire, where items of interest include Victorian jewellery, Art Deco enamel, a toy football team, possibly the world's smallest stuffed dog and a Venetian drug jar that might be worth a fortune - but only if it's original. Expert Paul Atterbury also casts his eye over an elaborate carved chair - inspired by, of all things, the MPs' expenses scandal.

programs.title: The Angry Silence
programs.desc: A factory worker is suspicious of a new employee who persuades the workforce to go on strike, and so steadfastly refuses to join in the protest. He finds himself an outcast, but is unwilling to back down despite the fierce reprisals from his former friends. Drama, starring Richard Attenborough and Michael Craig.

programs.title: The Derbyshire Auction House
programs.desc: A vast collection of gramophones and vintage radios get the auction buzzing. Plus, a 15-carat gold charm bracelet and a rare royal mug steal the show.
